pages.title: Fermentation Barrel
pages.text: The fermentation barrel is used to ferment ales, lagers, wines, ciders, and mead. Each of these beverages will apply a different effect upon drinking.$(br2)Place the base fluid into the barrel with the appropriate yeast to produce a fermented product.$(br)The finished product can be extracted with a glass bottle.
The fermentation barrel can fit up to four buckets of fluid, but takes longer to process the more fluid is present.

pages.title: Start and Stop
pages.text: Fermentation starts automatically with matching fluid and yeast, including hopper input.$(br2)When manual controls are enabled, the gray stop square discards progress and unlocks contents. The green start arrow begins again.$(br2)Hover over the yeast for processing feedback.

pages.title: Manual Controls
pages.text: Manual controls use one setting for standard and large fermentation barrels.$(br2)In growthcraft_cellar-common.toml, under [fermentation_barrel], set allow_manual_unlock to true. The default is false.$(br2)Automatic processing and hopper input work with either setting.$(br2)See $(l:server_settings/fermentation_barrels)Server Settings$().
